propositions: Three identical O_EXCL lock-acquisition loops exist in enrich_drain.py, compact_trigger.py, and gc_trigger.py that should be consolidated into a single shared implementation

Release semantics differ between the three copies: enrich_drain wraps close+unlink in one try block (leaking on close failure), while compact_trigger and gc_trigger use two independent try blocks; the consolidated version must adopt the two-block form
The three copies differ in logging behavior and stamp formatting, but readers strip() both forms, so consolidation must standardize on no-newline and adopt drain's stamp-failure WARNING for all three

A new stamped_lock.py module must export stamped_file_lock() and release_stamped_lock() functions while leaving staleness logic and directory creation to callers, and all three worker modules must pass paths through it exclusively

The monkeypatch guard in test_lock_holder_labelling.py patches compact_trigger functions by module-level attribute name with no raising=False, so the six lock functions (_acquire_advisory_lock, _release_advisory_lock, _acquire_trigger_lock, release_trigger_lock, _acquire_worker_lock, release_worker_lock) must remain as unchanged module-level attributes
